gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-fs-epilogue: Baloo Chettan 2 leads with wide channels into every counter, so the text looks magnified without growing. Epilogue follows in a plain sans of curvy, wire-thin strokes and stubby ascender tips, which keeps the page loose.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-fs-fira-sans: Loud, round and unmistakably expressive up top, with a body that opens its s curves wide at both ends. Baloo Chettan 2 does the shouting; Fira Sans, sans-serif and tall in the x-height, does the explaining.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-fs-merriweather-s: Baloo Chettan 2 opens each counter through a wide channel, giving the heading a magnified, expressive look. And Merriweather Sans makes its tall lowercase look sturdy, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-fs-public-sans: Expressive on top, hefty underneath. Baloo Chettan 2 looks magnified through its wide counter channels, and Public Sans meets that with a plain sans body whose broad open counters carry the weight steadily.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-fs-ranade: Ranade reads as a spread-out sans-serif, its stroke ends set far apart and its weight shifting only slightly, like stretched rubber cord. And Baloo Chettan 2 above it, with wide channels into each counter, looks magnified and far more distinctive.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and sturdy, a heavy-looking strip of sans through the middle of the line with letters held open. But Baloo Chettan 2 above it looks magnified, its wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-general-sans: General Sans reads smooth, with a steady pen pressure and an x-height that fills the line. General Sans would carry a longer passage without a snag, since every bend is unobstructed, while Baloo Chettan 2 stays the expressive voice above.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-manrope: Wide channels run into every counter of Baloo Chettan 2, making its text look magnified at the same size. And Manrope answers with a wire-like monoline sans, bright gaps at each curve's mouth and barely any step from capital to lowercase.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-montserrat: Montserrat brings a geometric plain sans with lots of white space leading into each curve and oversized e and a counters. Baloo Chettan 2 is best at expressive, magnified headings, while Montserrat is best at gliding under the eye like wire.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-satoshi: Satoshi is a plain sans with a soaring x-height, a wide-open e and every stroke cut to one width, like a stylus held at fixed pressure. And Baloo Chettan 2 gives the heading its magnified, expressive voice, so a longer passage would feel approachable underneath.
